Garage description
The armored plates called "The Rock" are mined from huge rock formations, using an ancient Egyptian technology. Dry pegs are hammered into the rock, then soaked with water till they swell, breaking the rock into smooth blocks of stone. This camouflage is the definition of "hand-made".
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on August 26, 2010.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Rock was worth 210,000 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Fieldmarshal.
Some users prefer to call this paint by its other name, "Dwayne."
Legacy paint description:
A paint that is excellent against Twins. Provides additional protection from Hammer, Isida and Freeze. Useful in short to mid-range battles. Gives your tank a rocky appearance.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
